definitions.gloss: shade of a tree, tree shade
definitions.explanation: The cool, shaded area beneath or near a tree, blocked from direct sunlight by the tree's leaves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧{木陰|こかげ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}もう→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: It's hot, so let's rest in the shade of the tree.

examples.japanese: {木陰|こかげ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate my lunch in the shade of a tree.

examples.japanese: {木陰|こかげ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{涼|すず}しくて→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The tree shade is cool and pleasant.
I had tea in the shade of a large tree in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{真夏|まなつ}→真夏：27793_manatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}くて→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{辛|つら}かった→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{並木道|なみきみち}→並木道：17520_namikimichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{木陰|こかげ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}ると→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{急|きゅう}に→急に：00263_kyuuni⟧⟦{涼|すず}しく→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The midsummer sun was so strong it was hard to walk, but it suddenly got cool when I entered the tree-lined shade.

notes:
{木陰|こかげ} refers to the shade provided by a tree. {木|こ} means 'tree' and {陰|かげ} means 'shade/shadow.'

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {木陰|こかげ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧: to rest in the tree shade
- {木陰|こかげ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to go into the tree shade
- ⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧{木陰|こかげ}: cool tree shade
- {木陰|こかげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ベンチ→ベンチ：00013_benchi⟧: bench in the tree shade

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{日陰|ひかげ}→日陰：00100_hikage⟧: shade (general, not from sun)
- ⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧: shadow
- ⟦{物陰|ものかげ}→物陰：15765_monokage⟧: shadow/shade of an object
- ⟦{日向|ひなた}→日向：05044_hinata⟧: sunny spot (opposite)

SEASONAL USE:
- Particularly appreciated in summer
- {木陰|こかげ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{涼|すず}む→涼む：03927_suzumu⟧: to cool off in tree shade
